# Reading showcase

A page of everything the reading view draws. It links to the [guide](docs/guide.md), to a [missing page](docs/nope.md) and to [a section](#diagrams). Code references open in your editor: `src/main.rs:12`, and plain text like src/main.rs:3 works too.

## Text and lists

Paragraphs keep a comfortable measure at **any** zoom: *emphasis*, `inline code`, ~~strike~~, a footnote[^1] and an autolink https://example.com. Press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>F</kbd> to find in page.

- [x] Render Markdown
- [x] Keep my place when the file changes
- [ ] Review the changes

1. First
2. Second
   - nested item
   - another one

> [!NOTE]
> Alerts come with a title and an icon.

> [!WARNING]
> Reading is the main mode. Beautiful, clear reading is a requirement.

## Code

```rust
fn main() {
    let name = "PerMark";
    println!("Hello, {name}!");
}
```

```json
{ "name": "permark", "private": true, "version": "0.6.0" }
```

## Tables

| Feature  | Status  | Notes                         |
| -------- | ------- | ----------------------------- |
| Tables   | done    | Zebra rows, sticky header     |
| Math     | done    | KaTeX, loaded when needed     |
| Diagrams | done    | Mermaid and PlantUML in page  |

## Math

Inline math $E = mc^2$ sits in the text. A display formula:

$$
\int_0^\infty e^{-x^2}\,dx = \frac{\sqrt{\pi}}{2}
$$

## Diagrams

```mermaid
graph LR
  A[Markdown] --> B(Render)
  B --> C{Sanitize}
  C -->|safe| D[Page]
  C -->|unsafe| E[Dropped]
```

## Prompt blocks

<context>
You are reading a prompt file. The tags below fold, and **Markdown inside them** still renders.

- Variables look like {{customer_name}} and are marked.
- Files are linked: see @docs/guide.md for the guide.
</context>

<instructions>
1. Be brief.
2. Quote the source.
</instructions>

[^1]: Footnotes list at the end of the page, with a way back.

# Guide

Back to the [readme](../README.md). More ideas in [ideas](../notes/ideas.md#second-idea).

## Getting started

Open a folder, pick a document in the tree, read it. Links between documents work like a wiki: use Alt+Left to go back.

![PerMark logo](img/logo.png)

## Shortcuts

| Keys         | Action          |
| ------------ | --------------- |
| Ctrl+F       | Find in page    |
| Alt+Left     | Back            |
| Ctrl+= / Ctrl+- | Zoom         |

name: project-rules

# Project rules

<instructions>
Read @docs/guide.md first. Greet {{user}} by name.
</instructions>

<example>
Input: a question about the **guide**.
Output: a short answer with a link.
</example>

Cargo.toml.text:
# The docs site generator.
[package]
name = "docs-site"
version = "0.4.2"
edition = "2021"
description = "Builds the project documentation"
authors = ["Ana Souza", "Bo Chen"]
publish = false

[dependencies]
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
tokio = "1.40"
pulldown-cmark = "0.12"

# Release build
[profile.release]
opt-level = 3
lto = true
codegen-units = 1

[package.metadata.deploy]
host = "docs.example.org"
api_token = "dp_live_4f9a1c77b2"
retries = 3

docker-compose.yml.text:
# Local stack
name: docs
services:
  web:
    image: nginx:1.27   # pinned
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
      - "8443:443"
    environment:
      MODE: production
      DEBUG: false
      API_KEY: sk-live-9d2c41aa
    depends_on: [db]
  db:
    image: 'postgres:16'
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: docs
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: hunter2-prod
    healthcheck:
      interval: 10s
      retries: 5

.env.example.text:
# App
NODE_ENV=development
PORT=3000
DEBUG=false

# Database
DATABASE_URL=postgres://docs:pa55w0rd@localhost:5432/docs
DB_PASSWORD="s3cr3t pass"
export API_KEY='sk-live-abc123'
SECRET_KEY_BASE=
APP_NAME=Docs Site # shown in the header
BASE_URL=${HOST}/api

.editorconfig.text:
# EditorConfig is awesome: https://EditorConfig.org
root = true

[*]
indent_style = space
indent_size = 2
end_of_line = lf
charset = utf-8
trim_trailing_whitespace = true
insert_final_newline = true

# Tabs for Makefiles
[Makefile]
indent_style = tab

[*.{js,py}]
max_line_length = 100

config/app.properties.text:
# Server
server.port=8080
server.servlet.context-path = /api

# Database
spring.datasource.url=jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/docs
spring.datasource.username: docs
spring.datasource.password=s3cr3t-prop
spring.jpa.show-sql true
spring.jpa.open-in-view=false

app.name=Docs Site
app.greeting=Hello, \u00e9\u00e8!

*.log
!important.log
